theory: The probability illustration draws $2.4e^{-0.45x}$ on $[0,5]$, whose integral is $(16/3)(1-e^{-2.25})$, approximately $4.7712$, so it is not a PDF. Normalize the illustrated curve and adjust its boundary lines consistently. Clarify that zero outside a stated interval applies to a density supported on that interval, rather than every PDF necessarily having bounded support or requiring piecewise notation; the booklet also includes unbounded densities.
